metadata.title: Coffee cooling data from more pots (one measured series)

provenance.citation: Sedlacek J., Dolejsi J. (2010). A physical description of coffee cooling in a pot. American Journal of Physics (preprint PDF; journal volume not verified from this run).
provenance.source_type: peer-reviewed article, figure-digitised (vector markers on PDF page 1, Fig. 1)
provenance.pdf_tls_note: The host serves an incomplete certificate chain; the PDF was fetched with TLS verification disabled. SHA-256 is recorded in README.md.
provenance.measurement_error_source: paper text: 'estimated error of our measurement is about 0.3 C' (mercury thermometer)
provenance.digitisation_method: PyMuPDF vector drawings; 29 white-filled square markers on page 1; axes calibrated from centres of tick-label text boxes (x 0-160 min, y 20-90 C); overlay check passed
provenance.digitisation_error_basis: max residual of the tick-label linear calibration (y 0.262 pt over 1.258 pt per C; x 0.084 pt over 1.383 pt per min)

stated_in_source.time_sampling: 'in every five minutes' (text); read spacing 1-6 min
stated_in_source.cup_mass_or_evaporation_rate: not stated per time point; Table I gives fitted parameters only
stated_in_source.pot_geometry: not stated in text (china pot shown in Fig. 7, raster)

provenance.series_scope_note: The only measured curve in the PDF is Fig. 1. Metal-pot, vacuum-pot and water-with-fat series are not published as curves (Table I gives fitted parameters only), so they are not digitised.
provenance.earlier_artifact_comparison: Not performed: the earlier china-pot digitisation (art_-CfKbDAPDpKm) was not available to this executor, so the 0.2 C agreement check was not run.
provenance.langer_2018_note: Langer et al. 2018 (Zenodo 1402983, CC BY 4.0): no raw time series attached; not included. The 65 C crossing-time conflict is not addressed here.
